caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall clock with a rectangular body in a brown, woodgrain finish. The clock face is circular and positioned in the upper section of the clock, displaying black Roman numerals on a white background, along with two black clock hands and the name "Thomas Lockhart" written on it. Above the clock face, the top part features a decorative, symmetrical crest with curved elements and a vertical, finial-like ornament at the center. At the lower part of the clock's front is an oval, gold-colored inlay or plate. The clock case has a simple, straight-lined structure with a flat base. The background is plain and off-white, and there are some faint stains or marks on the background, as well as the faint signature “Gilbert Sackerman” towards the bottom left.
title: Mantel Clock
